Bring your own DASHSCOPE_API_KEY; endpoint/model/budgets configurable, redirect-proof HTTP client, works in every agent preset.
- [whiteS18/dsh-image-generation](https://github.com/whiteS18/dsh-image-generation) - Configure multiple image providers in Settings and call image_generate with the one selected model; images save under generate/image and show inline in the conversation.
- [WongYuYe/dsh-appshots](https://github.com/WongYuYe/dsh-appshots) - Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows), or the camera button, to grab the frontmost window, attach it to the current chat, and inject a VoiceOver-style accessibility tree as hidden context.
- [WSL043/dsh-image-viewer](https://github.com/WSL043/dsh-image-viewer) - Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.
- [wulusai2333/mimo-vision](https://github.com/wulusai2333/mimo-vision) - `describe_image` tool: a vision bridge that sends images to mimo-v2.5 through the opencode Zen API (credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, free route first with paid fallback) and returns text descriptions for text-only models, with native passthrough and ImageMagick transcoding of SVG/TIFF/HEIC formats.
- [xiaoshihou514/dsh-vision](https://github.com/xiaoshihou514/dsh-vision) - Native vision capability extension, using either Zhipu (free) or Qwen-VL (local).
- [xiaoyuink/dsh-image-vision](https://github.com/xiaoyuink/dsh-image-vision) - Image understanding for any DSH model: vision, OCR, grounding, and crop tools with domain presets for histopathology, cell biology, anatomy, clinical images and scientific figures.
- [xiaozhe7772222/dsh-draw-router](https://github.com/xiaozhe7772222/dsh-draw-router) - Unified image generation router for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): auto-discovers image models from any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, provides draw_image and draw_list_sources tools, supports SenseNova, StepFun, Agnes, Qwen, Flux, SD, Imagen and more.
- [ximengxiaolan/dsh-vision-bridge](https://github.com/ximengxiaolan/dsh-vision-bridge) - Composer-attached images are transcribed to text by an OpenAI-compatible vision model before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.
- [xing666173/dsh-vision-hub#tool-vision](https://github.com/xing666173/dsh-vision-hub/tree/main/tool-vision) - Enhanced vision toolbox: 14 pixel-level vision tools (describe, ground, detect, crop, pixel-diff, OCR, long-screenshot OCR, vectorize, colors, cutout, screenshot, present, materialize, html-screenshot) driven by one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with clean \[图片: path] bridge markers, content-safety classification and rate-limit auto-retry.
- [xsoc1/dsh-image-vision](https://github.com/xsoc1/dsh-image-vision) - Chat image-attachment bridge with a `view_image` tool for any OpenAI-compatible VLM (local Ollama or cloud): pasted/dropped images become `view_image` path markers before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.
- [Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins#vision-bridge](https://github.com/Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins/tree/main/plugins/vision-bridge) - Let text-only models see images: when a picture arrives with a placeholder like \[image omitted because this model accepts text only], the model calls the vision_describe tool and the plugin forwards the image reference plus the question to a multimodal model, retrying with a fallback model on failure. Configured in the settings page and persisted via the official settings API.
- [ysr666/dsh-vision-router](https://github.com/ysr666/dsh-vision-router) - Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.
- [yxqfg/phone-lens#phone-lens](https://github.com/yxqfg/phone-lens/tree/main/packages/phone-lens) - Turn a phone camera into a live viewfinder and photo input for your dsh session, over LAN or USB.
- [zhiwuli0228/dsh-image-router](https://github.com/zhiwuli0228/dsh-image-router) - Digests the images in a prompt with a vision model before admission, so any model — a text-only one included — can read them without the session ever switching models, and adds a describe_image tool for image paths.
- [zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui#packages/dsh-tool-describe-image](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/tree/main/packages/dsh-tool-describe-image) - A `describe_image` vision tool for text-only models: images (local path, URL, attachment) go to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint and only the returned text enters the session.
- [zmm863-commits/dsh-agnes-studio](https://github.com/zmm863-commits/dsh-agnes-studio) - AI image and video studio as a floating DSH panel, so creation runs alongside the conversation instead of replacing it: text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios; text-to-video and image-to-video with first-frame control at 4-12 seconds; short-drama mode that imports a script (.txt/.md/.json), breaks it into storyboard shots for preview and batch generation; and a prompt-expert workspace. Zero runtime dependencies.

### Voice & Audio

- [3274375092/dsh-voice](https://github.com/3274375092/dsh-voice) - Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: speak into the microphone and the recognized text is submitted as a normal chat message, via local or browser speech recognition.
- [AI-Galaxy-GPU/dsh-sound](https://github.com/AI-Galaxy-GPU/dsh-sound) - Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).
- [Alan2Z/dsh-speak](https://github.com/Alan2Z/dsh-speak) - Zero-dependency, event-driven voice announcement plugin: no extra model, no token cost. Speaks with the system's built-in natural voice, supporting both Windows and macOS; final-reply announcements, approval & question alerts, optional event announcements (turn end, command done, goal change, tool errors, todo updates), replayable final replies, and a bilingual visual settings page.
- [anweat/dsh-voice-webspeech](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-voice-webspeech) - Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).

- [beiyege-01/dsh-voice-ai-girlfriend-plugin](https://github.com/beiyege-01/dsh-voice-ai-girlfriend-plugin) - Voice AI girlfriend for the Web UI: FunASR mic input, Qwen3-TTS spoken replies, companion animation window, and two-way QQ chat (text/voice/image push) via NapCat.
- [berserk0501/dsh-soundscape](https://github.com/berserk0501/dsh-soundscape) - Dual-MediaPlayer daemon ($think loop + $fx one-shots) with volume ducking, mood-aware sounds (smooth/struggle/deep_think triggered by consecutive success/failure streaks and prolonged agent runtime), 15 built-in PCM WAV synthesised from sine/square waveforms, per-tool sound mapping with 51 categorised tools, custom WAV/MP3 drop-in with auto-conversion, and a full settings UI with dark-mode fix.
- [biliye/dsh-voice-call](https://github.com/biliye/dsh-voice-call) - Voice call assistant for the DSH Web GUI: a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, FunASR HTTP or streaming speech recognition, MiniMax or OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate subagent sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.
- [CAOGGL/dsh-ding](https://github.com/CAOGGL/dsh-ding) - Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).
- [cccc12138/dsh-read-aloud](https://github.com/cccc12138/dsh-read-aloud) - Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine, and hover it for a speed and voice panel.
- [duoduoqian708/dsh-voice-talk](https://github.com/duoduoqian708/dsh-voice-talk) - Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. An existing GPT-SoVITS can be used instead, and it is the same voice model.

- [WuJiaoJue/dsh-later](https://github.com/WuJiaoJue/dsh-later) - Scheduled reminders and delayed send for DSH: /later delivers what you type as yourself at the time you pick, while the timer panel (or /schedule) posts a reminder row — even with the page closed. (scheduled send / reminders / delayed send)
- [wwweljf/dsh-plugins#dsh-wx-push](https://github.com/wwweljf/dsh-plugins/tree/master/plugins/dsh-wx-push) - Auto-send every DSH turn result to WeChat: listens for task completion, extracts the final assistant message and pushes it raw via the WeChat iLink bot (real delivery check, never fake success). Requires the wechat-acp daemon, a separately installed process you log into WeChat with.
- [xiagaogaozi/dsh-subagent-pool](https://github.com/xiagaogaozi/dsh-subagent-pool) - Maintains reusable named subagent profiles for DeepSeek Harness and runs them with per-profile model, reasoning effort, and agent-preset settings.
- [XMoon/dsh-subagent-router](https://github.com/XMoon/dsh-subagent-router) - Adds subagent_route and subagent_fork_route delegation tools where the model itself picks the provider/model route for each child; the deployment only sets the spawn/fork backend, background policy and allowedProviders allowlist, while continuable children and background jobs reuse the official send_message / job_output tools.
- [yakoylp/dsh-md-convert](https://github.com/yakoylp/dsh-md-convert) - Convert Office documents and PDFs (including scanned ones) to structurally formatted Markdown via a CPU-first routing OCR pipeline (RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet).
- [yangdcm/dsh-expert-team](https://github.com/yangdcm/dsh-expert-team) - Role-based multi-agent team for DeepSeek Harness. The /team command assembles up to 12 specialist subagents (product, architect, researcher, UI, backend, frontend, database, security, reviewer, QA, DevOps, docs) and runs a nine-phase gated pipeline (clarify, research, design, spec review, plan approval, implement, review, test, deliver) over a shared workspace of artifacts (SPEC, PLAN, TASKS, STATE, REVIEW, TEST). Quality gates are enforced by plugin code rather than requested in prompts: an unfinished task cannot be marked completed, quality findings must be adjudicated by the reviewer or QA role, and coverage gaps or rework over budget appear live in the overlay and in /team status. Ships a live team overlay (phases, roster with per-role models, task DAG, artifact preview, decision buttons), a persistent-team mode that resumes across sessions, and per-run token and time accounting. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
- [yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-scheduler](https://github.com/yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-scheduler) - Cron task scheduler for DSH: on schedule, automatically creates a new session and injects your prompt as its first message, with task history and manual run/stop controls. Also runs KNJ workflows: pick files directly (stored as persistent snapshots, re-handed to the workflow on every fire) or reference them by path. Its sidebar entry is provided by dsh-knj-menu; install together: dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu.
- [yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-workflow](https://github.com/yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-workflow) - Config-driven development-task orchestration for DSH: graph workflows (task/gateway/human nodes) with per-stage persistence, plus an in-editor AI assistant that configures workflows through conversation with live validation. Hand documents to nodes as generic attachments (no declaration needed): files land in the task workspace and ${inputs.附件} gives the newline-joined absolute paths, so a node parses them with its own prompt.
- [yangyongzhen/dsh-article-publish](https://github.com/yangyongzhen/dsh-article-publish) - Publish articles to CSDN / Juejin / CNBlog directly from the session, no external server.
- [yangyongzhen/dsh-scheduler](https://github.com/yangyongzhen/dsh-scheduler) - Cron/one-shot scheduled tasks: run shell commands or fire webhooks on a schedule, with optional ServerChan/DingTalk/Feishu/webhook delivery of results.
- [yaopushen/dsh-plugin-background-tasks](https://github.com/yaopushen/dsh-plugin-background-tasks) - Antigravity-style run_command for DSH: short commands return inline within a configurable wait window (default 10s) while longer ones auto-promote into ctx.jobs for later collection and completion notices — executed via ctx.shell under the session sandbox and approval pipeline.
- [ygcdsj/dsh-home-migrate](https://github.com/ygcdsj/dsh-home-migrate) - Export and import DeepSeek Harness configuration across machines as same-OS .dshmig archives, with credential redaction, verification and rollback.
- [Yisan0429/dsh-itranslation#bundle](https://github.com/Yisan0429/dsh-itranslation/tree/main/packages/itranslation/bundle) - Whole-book translation production line for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic chapter detection and segmentation, per-chapter subagent translation, glossary control, full-book review, targeted revision, and auditable meta.json evidence.
- [yx222yx/DSH-Feedback-Bridge](https://github.com/yx222yx/DSH-Feedback-Bridge) - Turns DSH conversations into reviewable community feedback and, after confirmation, submits it to the official DeepSeek Harness Discussions.
- [yyyy231209/ai-company-framework](https://github.com/yyyy231209/ai-company-framework) - AI Company Framework: turn one sentence into a multi-agent company — 15 flat Skills (boss/pipeline/role-template/11 roles/generic customer-memory), 7 workflow templates, AgentTeams runtime + activity panel, employee sidebar with per-session isolation, Feishu bot bridge (boss and per-employee bots, group routing, autonomous push, human decision gate, external-contact guide), per-customer SQLite memory with three-layer memory (cross-group merge), /company mode switch; no RAG.
- [Z-Asset/alpharsi](https://github.com/Z-Asset/alpharsi) - AlphaRSI — three-role self-improvement loop that evolves the training recipe of alpha sequence models. Operator runs walk-forward, Evaluator grades with OOS RankIC, Refiner proposes hyperparameters via TPE Bayesian search; only strictly-better recipes are kept. Offline one-command run, data bundle shipped with sha1 reconciliation, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/attest](https://github.com/Z-Asset/attest) - Training attestation — reproducible, attributable, auditable off-site standardized training for asset pricing. Hard-gates four failure modes (half-refresh, hash mismatch, unknown-read-as-pass, master pollution). Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/ZA_analysis](https://github.com/Z-Asset/ZA_analysis) - Model training stage — end-to-end analysis, model training, and estimation for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/ZA_data](https://github.com/Z-Asset/ZA_data) - Data stage — data discovery and quality assessment for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/ZA_literature](https://github.com/Z-Asset/ZA_literature) - Literature review stage — search, synthesis, and citation-chain tracking for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/ZA_ppt](https://github.com/Z-Asset/ZA_ppt) - PPT stage — presentation generation (Beamer/Quarto) from the paper for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/ZA_report](https://github.com/Z-Asset/ZA_report) - Report stage — academic paper writing for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
- [zclDragon/dsh-tool-generate-image](https://github.com/zclDragon/dsh-tool-generate-image) - Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work.
- [ZEM17/dsh-subagent-agy](https://github.com/ZEM17/dsh-subagent-agy) - Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a DSH product subagent: delegate tasks to a Gemini coding agent with your Antigravity login (no API key), with conversation follow-ups, background streaming progress, image analysis by path, and a pop-up login window.
- [zenghaili0901/dsh-bot-mode](https://github.com/zenghaili0901/dsh-bot-mode) - Bot Mode for DeepSeek Harness: a roster of named bots with avatars, personas and per-bot chats, each backed by one durable continuable subagent session that keeps memory across turns.
- [ZhenHuangLab/dsh-sync](https://github.com/ZhenHuangLab/dsh-sync) - Policy-driven Git sync for DSH settings and profile configuration, with secret-aware projections, conflict review, and per-line apply controls.
- [ziduup/dsh-programming-mode](https://github.com/ziduup/dsh-programming-mode) - Programming Mode agent preset bundle: the standard coding agent with its persona mandating the Superpowers discipline (skills first, brainstorming before building, plans before code, TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion) plus an always-on Ponytail code-volume discipline (7-rung minimal-code ladder, default full); ships all twenty skills bundled (14 superpowers + 6 ponytail) and mechanically injects the full using-superpowers skill into every new session's first request.
- [ZSeven-W/dsh-crew](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-crew) - Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code or Codex: native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge for vision and image generation.
- [zsspub/dsh-personal-todo](https://github.com/zsspub/dsh-personal-todo) - Persistent personal todos shared across DeepSeek Harness sessions and projects: SQLite storage, Agent tools, a native sidebar and turn-tail cards, with user-managed workflows or optional dispatch of individual todos to Agent sessions.
- [ztl34245881-commits/dsh-task-planner](https://github.com/ztl34245881-commits/dsh-task-planner) - Task planning with experience muscle-memory: condition-reflex recall of past solutions, LLM capability matching, and auto-persisted lessons.
- [zzhzz/dsh-ask-peer](https://github.com/zzhzz/dsh-ask-peer) - Peer-to-peer colleague-agent consultation for DSH: ask one or several configured peers, queue asynchronous questions, discover peers through signed friend cards, and review inbound requests in the Web UI.

### Git & Code Review

- [7dgroup-ai/dsh-skill-7d-git-commit](https://github.com/7dgroup-ai/dsh-skill-7d-git-commit) - Checks git commit messages against the 7DGroup convention (Chinese type tags, length and punctuation rules) before committing, as a client-side guard before GitLab pre-receive hooks.
- [9087/dsh-diff-approval](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval) - Pending-change review for DeepSeek Harness: every `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` change is collected automatically into the file list, where a single change block, the blocks within a selection, or the whole file can be kept or reverted, and undo/redo is supported. It imports the workspace's version-control changes, shows the diff in a single-column or side-by-side view, and provides a Markdown preview in which changes can also be kept or reverted, in-file search, block jumping and copyable line references; the diff data is stored persistently, so the review continues after a restart.
- [988hj7tczd-oss/harness-github](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/harness-github) - DSH GitHub connector: review PRs, triage issues, debug CI, prepare changes (18 tools, gh-first + REST fallback, approval-gated writes).
- [a792883583/dsh-git-panel](https://github.com/a792883583/dsh-git-panel) - Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.
- [Akimiya-z/codex-guard#dsh](https://github.com/Akimiya-z/codex-guard/tree/main/dsh) - Pre-submit pull-request hygiene checks inside DeepSeek Harness: scans the current diff for TODO leftovers, hardcoded secrets, and non-conventional commit subjects.
- [alpacachen/dsh-worktree](https://github.com/alpacachen/dsh-worktree) - A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
- [andyfan1094/dsh-github](https://github.com/andyfan1094/dsh-github) - GitHub account management plus a local Git workflow for the web GUI with clone, fast-forward pull, status, commit, push, and host-side push guards.
- [AngelosZou/dsh-github-router](https://github.com/AngelosZou/dsh-github-router) - Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.
- [Binaryinject/dsh-review-checkout](https://github.com/Binaryinject/dsh-review-checkout) - Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards), a review tab with syntax-highlighted diffs, real line numbers, open-at-line and a draggable split, light/dark presets that follow the DSH theme, typography that follows DSH and installed skins (or any font on the machine, with a px stepper), and one-click per-turn revert — powered by the official session channel.
- [BOWLUNA/dsh-zcode-git](https://github.com/BOWLUNA/dsh-zcode-git) - Structured git tools for DeepSeek Harness agents: status, diff, log, branch, commit and stash. Output is pinned with ten `git -c` overrides so a user pager, colour or quotepath setting cannot reshape what the agent reads; every invocation is an argv array, so no shell ever parses an argument; and the mutating actions go through the harness approval service, refusing rather than proceeding when no approval service is mounted.
- [BrambleXu/dsh-revdiff](https://github.com/BrambleXu/dsh-revdiff) - Native interactive Git diff review for DeepSeek Harness with structured annotations sent back to the current Agent session.

- [cirelir/dsh-change-review](https://github.com/cirelir/dsh-change-review) - Session change-review plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session and renders line-level diffs with customizable colors, with session isolation, subagent aggregation, and SSE live updates.
- [DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-git-graph](https://github.com/DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui/tree/main/packages/dsh-git-graph) - Git branch selector and Git graph in the conversation header of the dsh web GUI.
- [Dayi-Z/dsh-git-manager](https://github.com/Dayi-Z/dsh-git-manager) - A GitHub-connected visual git manager for DeepSeek Harness: guided GitHub-Flow steps, commit graph with PR/CI badges, one-click GitHub login, PR and issue management, and structured git tools for the agent. Renamed from gitcompass in 2.0.0.
- [dd2673/dsh-wending-git-workbench](https://github.com/dd2673/dsh-wending-git-workbench) - Codex-style Git workbench: workspace-scoped changes, diff, stage, commit, guarded branch operations, graph history, fetch, fast-forward pull, and upstream push through official plugin APIs.
- [delock/dsh-pr-board](https://github.com/delock/dsh-pr-board) - Maintainer and developer PR board for the DSH sidebar: a five-state review queue (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), a three-column issue board, and a global view of the PRs you authored (my move / waiting on others / merged), with CI rollup badges, an inactivity filter, and one click per card to open or start the matching review conversation.
- [dennisrongo/dsh-plugins#dsh-git](https://github.com/dennisrongo/dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/dsh-git) - Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via fs.watch plus a changeToken poll.

- [EIGHTfs/dsh-git-push](https://github.com/EIGHTfs/dsh-git-push) - Git commit-and-push automation for DSH with pre-push auditing, rule-based quality scoring, SSH key generation, and a three-tab settings sidebar.

- [Fectivnfy112357/github-explore](https://github.com/Fectivnfy112357/github-explore) - GitHub search, discovery and audit scripts wrapped as a SKILL.md pack around the gh CLI: repo search, multi-axis explore, trending, repo summaries, similar projects, code search, issue/PR search and org audits; ships as a dsh bundle (and on npm).
- [fengbinmov/dsh-git-panel](https://github.com/fengbinmov/dsh-git-panel) - The session page has an extra "Git" page; on the left is a preview of the non-staged/staged changes, and on the right is a diff preview with a row-level action bar (staged/discarded).
- [Funnyvalentine00/dsh-github-push](https://github.com/Funnyvalentine00/dsh-github-push) - One-step GitHub uploader: initializes git, auto-creates or improves README, sets repository topics, and pushes a local project to GitHub.

- [H2O-MERO/dsh-git-sidebar](https://github.com/H2O-MERO/dsh-git-sidebar) - VSCode-style uncommitted-changes sidebar docked to the right of the DSH web conversation page: staged / unstaged / untracked file groups, status badges, per-file +/− line counts, click-to-expand diff, rename as old → new, untracked content preview, and open with the system default application.

- [KannaKuron/dsh-ide-git](https://github.com/KannaKuron/dsh-ide-git) - JetBrains-style Git tool window for the sidebar: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes list and commit box, plus branch, tag and stash actions, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset and fetch/pull/push.
- [kaziii/dsh-github-connector#github](https://github.com/kaziii/dsh-github-connector/tree/main/packages/github/github) - GitHub Device Flow connect plus an in-conversation PR workflow: a status bar above the composer for create / AI-review / merge, and github_* tools for search, issue and PR read and write.
- [Kevin-McIsaac/dsh-workspace-git-badge#dsh-git-badge](https://github.com/Kevin-McIsaac/dsh-workspace-git-badge/tree/main/dsh-git-badge) - Git status badges for DSH: sidebar workspace-row badges and an input-row chip showing the current conversation's workspace git state, with event-driven freshness over SSE.
- [kp-z/dsh-dev-git-graph#dsh-dev-git-graph](https://github.com/kp-z/dsh-dev-git-graph/tree/main/packages/dsh-dev-git-graph) - A Git Graph tab for DSH Web: a faithful port of vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 that registers a native tab in the dsh-better-sidebar right rail (prerequisite), auto-binds to the session workspace, runs the full git operations (checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash) directly on the host, and opens file diffs in the built-in DiffTab.
- [LaoYueHanNi/dsh-git-worktree](https://github.com/LaoYueHanNi/dsh-git-worktree) - Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.

- [Letter2025/dsh-task-worktree](https://github.com/Letter2025/dsh-task-worktree) - Task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: durable per-repo manifest, worktree mode injects a creation instruction with your first message under an automatic worktree/ branch prefix, header badge instead of workspace clutter, and bring-back or force-remove cleanup.
- [lonelymoon87/dsh-gitflow](https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-gitflow) - Adds approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.
- [LoserFox/dsh-git-identity](https://github.com/LoserFox/dsh-git-identity) - Pin Git commits to the environment's own author identity; env-var injection overrides all `git config` settings.

- [lucky8197/dsh-code-smell](https://github.com/lucky8197/dsh-code-smell) - Code smell radar: statically scans TODO/FIXME debt, stub implementations, long lines, oversized files and duplicated blocks, with severity-sorted read-only fix suggestions.
- [lucky8197/dsh-git-hygiene](https://github.com/lucky8197/dsh-git-hygiene) - Git hygiene checker: read-only scan of merged and stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files and uncommitted work, with cleanup suggestions (it never deletes anything).
- [luomeii/dsh-review-squad](https://github.com/luomeii/dsh-review-squad) - Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one severity-grouped report from /review or a code_review tool call.
- [margbug01/dsh-ma-plugins#dsh-librarian](https://github.com/margbug01/dsh-ma-plugins/tree/main/dsh-librarian) - Evidence-first GitHub research subagent with bounded tools and in-memory request caching.

- [mays-hi/dsh-git-idea](https://github.com/mays-hi/dsh-git-idea) - Git integration for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer shows the current branch and the pending-change count, opens a branch switcher on hover and an IDEA-style VCS panel on click (branch tree, commit graph, changes and staging, commit detail, file diff), plus a settings page for commit identity, the git binary and the network flags. Registers no model tools with DSH.
- [MeghanBao/dsh-backstory](https://github.com/MeghanBao/dsh-backstory) - A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.
- [meyaomiao/dsh-github-workbench](https://github.com/meyaomiao/dsh-github-workbench) - GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.
- [MichengAI/dsh-code-review](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-code-review) - Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.
- [Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect](https://github.com/Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect) - Connects your GitHub account to DSH agents from the composer GitHub button (OAuth device flow or personal access token) and lets them call the GitHub API through the github_api tool.
- [MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-git-manager](https://github.com/MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-git-manager) - Git workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness: a repo-gated composer button opens a settings-style panel for diff/commit, branch, conflict, and worktree management, plus a commit history with branch-graph lines.
- [NEAZ71eve/dsh-tool-github](https://github.com/NEAZ71eve/dsh-tool-github) - GitHub REST API tools + browser sidebar panel: repos, search, issues, PRs, comments, account binding (credential-store), and one-click clone-as-workspace.
- [nightosong/gord-dsh-worktree](https://github.com/nightosong/gord-dsh-worktree) - Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness: five agent tools, a New Session picker that starts a session inside one, a sidebar tab for the uncommitted diff, a panel that unarchives or deletes archived sessions, and double-click rename. Removal refuses uncommitted or untracked changes and never removes the main worktree.
- [No-PRM/dsh-explorer#dsh-explorer](https://github.com/No-PRM/dsh-explorer/tree/main/dsh-plugins/dsh-explorer) - Git-first file-tree sidebar for the DSH web GUI: VS Code-style indent guides, M/A/U/D/R git decorations, HEAD-vs-worktree diff preview, media preview, and drag-to-reference (files/folders/selected code with line numbers) — pure plugin.
- [Noob-stupid/dsh-github-login](https://github.com/Noob-stupid/dsh-github-login) - Visual GitHub login without a terminal: in-window device flow, token synced into the gh CLI, and host status/launch endpoints.
- [Palaiologos1453/dsh-worktree-studio](https://github.com/Palaiologos1453/dsh-worktree-studio) - Human-operated Git worktree task board for DeepSeek Harness with validation-bound merge delivery.
- [PerryLink/dsh-github](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-github) - Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
- [pinzza/dsh-git-statusline](https://github.com/pinzza/dsh-git-statusline) - Compact Git status line for DSH Web: the current branch, staged and unstaged line changes, ahead/behind commit counts against upstream, and a clean-worktree marker — placeable in the sidebar footer, the session header, or above/below the composer, with the position switched on the settings page.
- [sakthiveltofficial/dsh-git-plugins#bundle](https://github.com/sakthiveltofficial/dsh-git-plugins/tree/main/packages/git/bundle) - Git and source-control plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness: local git operations plus GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gitea adapters, with self-evolving memory.
- [shenkonghui/dsh-worktree-manager](https://github.com/shenkonghui/dsh-worktree-manager) - Git worktree management for dsh — group workspaces by repository, create and switch worktrees, and browse their changes, commit history and file diffs.
- [Shyboy0499/dsh-git-tools](https://github.com/Shyboy0499/dsh-git-tools) - Four dependency-free local git tools (status, diff, log, commit) for DeepSeek Harness operating on the session workspace.
- [Starfie1d1272/dsh-github-skills](https://github.com/Starfie1d1272/dsh-github-skills) - Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with gh/git fallbacks.
- [sunshaobei/dsh-session-review](https://github.com/sunshaobei/dsh-session-review) - A strip above the composer listing files modified in the current session (collapsed by default), with a Review button opening a per-session change panel showing before/after hunks from the session's own edit/write tool results, no git required.
- [temotee2103/dsh-ci-co-pilot](https://github.com/temotee2103/dsh-ci-co-pilot) - GitHub CI co-pilot for DeepSeek Harness: PR review, CI failure fixing, issue triage and release notes.
- [TiChuXiXi/dsh-git-vcs](https://github.com/TiChuXiXi/dsh-git-vcs) - A right-sidebar Git panel in the IDEA style — local changes with per-file checkbox commits, a commit tree with per-commit details, branch, remote and stash management, push with a credential fallback, all driven by the plain git CLI.
- [Tlyer233/dsh-vscode-review#dsh-review](https://github.com/Tlyer233/dsh-vscode-review/tree/main/dsh-review) - Records every agent write, edit and shell `rm` into a shadow git repository, then reviews them hunk by hunk in VS Code — accept or revert each one. Needs the companion dsh-review-vscode extension; the panel only appears inside VS Code's webview.
- [truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-git-workflow](https://github.com/truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-git-workflow) - First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.
- [txy-ucas/dsh-workspace-snapshot](https://github.com/txy-ucas/dsh-workspace-snapshot) - Reports bounded, repository-relative Git status as structured data without staging, committing, or changing branches.
- [vclike/dsh-github-companion](https://github.com/vclike/dsh-github-companion) - 33 github_* tools covering REST reads, issue writes, Git data writes, private repo creation, and clone; in-process permission gate and cost-discipline companion skill; no gh CLI required.
- [Viger1/dsh-review](https://github.com/Viger1/dsh-review) - Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to independent verifiers tasked with refuting it, and one refutation drops it.
- [Web0926/dsh-llm-verifier](https://github.com/Web0926/dsh-llm-verifier) - Runs 3 or 5 coding-agent candidates in detached Git worktrees, validates their patches with project commands, ranks only passing candidates, and requires separate approval before applying the winner.
- [weibaohui/dsh-git-server](https://github.com/weibaohui/dsh-git-server) - Git server: embeds ts-gogs (a TypeScript reimplementation of Gogs) and serves a full Git service on its own port — HTTP clone/push, web UI, issues/PRs/wiki — reusing user-management credentials, start/stop from the settings page.
- [WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph](https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph) - Dedicated read-only Git Graph view beside Chat and Trajectory: commit topology, local/remote/tag refs, HEAD and working-tree status, search, filtering, first-parent mode, refresh, and load more.
- [wloops/dsh-git-worktree](https://github.com/wloops/dsh-git-worktree) - Git worktree Session Targets with isolated task sessions, Ready for Review, reversible Local Preview, human-confirmed delivery, environment retention and recovery, and same-session iteration.
- [Wongzexu/dsh-git-status](https://github.com/Wongzexu/dsh-git-status) - Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.
- [wuxiangru915/dsh-review-loop](https://github.com/wuxiangru915/dsh-review-loop) - Incremental diff reviewer for DSH: after approving a batch, only new changes since the checkpoint are shown, with a Web review panel and `/review` command that inject feedback back to the agent.
- [xbzbing/dsh-git-panel](https://github.com/xbzbing/dsh-git-panel) - IDE-style Git panel in the DSH Web GUI: a resident tab with a three-column overview (branch/tag list, searchable commit-history graph, commit detail with changed-file tree and message) and a changes page (stats bar, uncommitted list with per-file stage/unstage/discard, commit box with amend); side-by-side diffs carry lazy highlight.js syntax highlighting, on-demand between-hunk context expansion and word-level intra-line emphasis, with image files shown as before/after panes; plus a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar. Every git command runs as an argv array through the host subprocess service, cwd locked to the repo root.
- [xiaoksio/dsh-solution-explorer](https://github.com/xiaoksio/dsh-solution-explorer) - DSH Web GUI right sidebar: VS Code-style file explorer plus source control (git status, stage/unstage/discard, commit, diff, commit graph, fetch/pull/push sync, branch and remote management, git init, multi-repo switch, color-coded file status, file-type icons), an editor view that opens every file reached from the chat, the file tree or source control (Markdown/HTML/PDF/image previews, 15-language syntax highlighting, hunk-level diff editing, Ctrl+S save), file operations (new/move/copy/delete, reveal in file explorer), a collapsible icon rail, a multi-tab bottom terminal (ConPTY), and commit messages generated from the staged diff by a host-configured model.
- [xiongjiamu/dsh-atomgit](https://github.com/xiongjiamu/dsh-atomgit) - AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: six built-in AtomGit skills (plan issues, implement issues, review PRs, merge PRs, publish CLI releases, mirror to GitHub) plus ag CLI integration and platform-hosted MCP tools for repos, branches, issues, PRs, and search.
- [yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-version-control](https://github.com/yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-version-control) - Version-control workbench for the DSH Web sidebar: local changes grouped by type, per-file and multi-file staging, preview-confirmed commit / update / push, and a failure dialog that shows the raw Git output instead of a four-second toast.
- [yangyongzhen/dsh-git-workflow](https://github.com/yangyongzhen/dsh-git-workflow) - Conventional-commit enforcement, changelog generation, PR summaries and branch pushes through the plain git CLI.
- [yangzhe1991/dsh-code-review](https://github.com/yangzhe1991/dsh-code-review) - One-click standalone two-column code review page for Git diffs in the conversation: line numbers, add/delete coloring, character-level highlight, hunk-aware per-file sections, a file nav sidebar and a stats bar; line comments submit back to the DSH composer, and the UI follows the DSH locale.
- [yingtianlan/dsh-tauri-turnrewind](https://github.com/yingtianlan/dsh-tauri-turnrewind) - Turn-level workspace undo for Git worktrees: every agent turn gets a private snapshot, /undo previews a red/green diff card that is confirmed in place, files changed after the turn are refused with a conflict diff unless --force or --skip-conflicts is passed, and HEAD, index, stash and commit history of the user repository are never written.
- [yongshuai0314/dsh-turnsnap](https://github.com/yongshuai0314/dsh-turnsnap) - Zero-config per-turn git checkpoints: after every completed agent turn in a git workspace, stages all changes into one tagged \[turnsnap] commit (serialized queue, sandbox-policy aware), so any turn is a rollback point.
- [zengweicheng666/dsh-svn-tools](https://github.com/zengweicheng666/dsh-svn-tools) - SVN (Subversion) toolset for DeepSeek Harness: 33 agent tools (status, diff, log, blame, commit, merge, props, lock, changelist...) plus a sidebar panel with side-by-side BASE/working-copy diff, conflict resolution and AI commit logs.
- [zhitiaojun/dsh-auto-git](https://github.com/zhitiaojun/dsh-auto-git) - Runs git init in each newly registered DSH workspace, with an empty initial commit by default, so git-aware plugins have a repository to attach to; directories already inside a work tree are skipped.
- [zhu1090093659/dsh-web#packages/dsh-git-graph](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/tree/main/packages/dsh-git-graph) - Git branch selector and Git graph for the dsh web GUI: switch branches and explore branch-lane and commit history from the conversation header.
- [Zhucy123/dsh-update](https://github.com/Zhucy123/dsh-update) - One-click update for the local DeepSeek Harness checkout — compare versions, pull and rebuild, then restart, and roll back to any past release, all from a sidebar panel with live progress.
- [Zhucy123/source-code-mgmt](https://github.com/Zhucy123/source-code-mgmt) - Code management panel for the DSH web UI that handles everyday Git in five steps: ① env check auto-detects git/gh/ssh and one-click installs missing tools (gh mirror download sources speed up installs, Windows included) with check-update; ② SSH ed25519 key generation / connection tests plus one-click 443 config to bypass blocked port 22, with the Gitee personal token configured here; ③ repo status, side-by-side diffs, stage/commit, branch switching, history with revert/cherry-pick, one-click repo creation and push, auto-ignoring >100MB files; ④ lists all repos of your account for one-click clone; ⑤ five-step npm publish wizard. GitHub / Gitee dual-platform, with the UI switching between 中文 and English live.
- [ZIye1208/dsh-github-mcp](https://github.com/ZIye1208/dsh-github-mcp) - Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server as a DSH plugin: stores the PAT in DSH's credential center (.credentials.yaml) via github_set_token, and exposes GitHub tools as mcp__github__*.
- [ZIye1208/dsh-github-mcp-hint](https://github.com/ZIye1208/dsh-github-mcp-hint) - GitHub MCP helper panel: shows copyable example prompts at Settings → Plugins → GitHub MCP (random 4 from a 30-example pool), visualizes a public user's repo star/fork/language, and adds the gh_repo_stats and gh_current_user model tools.
- [zoahdev/dsh-github-intelligence](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-github-intelligence) - The most complete GitHub integration for dsh: repo overview, releases, issues, pull requests, contributors, search, and a deep repo report with TTL caching — no API key needed.
- [zoahdev/dsh-github-release-radar](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-github-release-radar) - Track releases and stars of any public GitHub repository from inside dsh agents — no API key needed.
- [zsxh1990/pr-genius](https://github.com/zsxh1990/pr-genius) - PR evaluation and improvement consultant: assesses PR success probability based on historical anti-patterns and success patterns, with one-click scoring and actionable suggestions.

- [br1nosense/dsh-wxauto-plugin](https://github.com/br1nosense/dsh-wxauto-plugin) - WeChat automation for DSH: push task progress to WeChat, listen for messages with keyword auto-reply, and a WeChat ↔ DSH two-way bridge controllable from the settings page, built on wxauto4.

- [CAI-MH/dsh-agent-bridge](https://github.com/CAI-MH/dsh-agent-bridge) - Bridge a Feishu bot to a DSH session: open a real session in a workspace, run tasks with the existing model and plugins, and report results back.

- [chromoany/dsh-notify-me](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me) - Message alerts and desktop notification for DSH — a system toast, a sound and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; the Settings page holds the master switch, sound and volume, the per-case toggles and the zh/en notification language.
- [Cloudto1/dsh-approval-chime](https://github.com/Cloudto1/dsh-approval-chime) - Plays a chime when DeepSeek Harness asks for approval; tone, volume and on/off are set in Settings → Notifications.

- [dingyi222666/dsh-session-notification](https://github.com/dingyi222666/dsh-session-notification) - Notifications for four session states, with browser alerts and prompts.

- [dsh-niao/dsh-niao-message](https://github.com/dsh-niao/dsh-niao-message) - macOS system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: aborted, max-tokens, blocked, interrupted and error events, pending questions and approvals, and completion or subagent-end via terminal-notifier; clicking a banner opens a configured app and returning to the page auto-dismisses them.
- [dsh-pulse/dsh-hermes-bridge](https://github.com/dsh-pulse/dsh-hermes-bridge) - Task-queue execution endpoint for DSH: requires a separately self-deployed Hermes Agent gateway plus your own WeChat inbound script; verified on a single environment — expect to adapt it.
- [falling-ts/dsh-web-ding](https://github.com/falling-ts/dsh-web-ding) - Plays a short synthesized ding in the browser tab the moment an agent finishes a turn, built entirely with the Web Audio API; no backend audio and no OS notification.
- [faukwaa/dsh-gap-feed](https://github.com/faukwaa/dsh-gap-feed) - During long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.

# dsh-memory-evolve 使用场景指南

> **一句话**：让 DSH 里的 AI 拥有跨会话的长期记忆、帮你管理待办与技能、还能拉起一群 AI 会话和外部 AI 代理协同干活——**越用越懂你，换会话不丢上下文**。
>
> 本指南按真实工作流组织，每个场景讲「适合谁、能做什么、怎么用、会得到什么」。
>
> 相关文档：[详细功能说明](README-详细说明.md) · [记忆同步](docs/记忆同步.md) · [更新日志](docs/CHANGELOG.md) · [English](README.en.md)

---

## 快速开始（安装）

插件包内自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch` 声明），`dsh plugin add` 安装后 **host 端自动注册，无需任何手动配置**。以 web profile 为例，两步装好：

```sh
# 1. 安装到 profile（本地目录用 link:，也可用 git/registry 包地址）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve

# 2. 重启 dsh web 即生效
```

> ⚠️ **不要再往 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 手动 insert 本插件**：bundle patch 已自动注册，重复 insert 同 id 会让加载器报 duplicate loader entry id 无法启动。完整说明见 [详细功能说明](README-详细说明.md)「标准安装」章节。

**修改默认配置**（如开启回合内记忆审查）：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 用 id 覆盖（顶层写法，非 insert）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-memory-evolve
  config:
    reviewEnabled: true      # 开启回合内记忆审查（默认关）
    reviewInterval: 10       # 每 10 个用户回合审查一次
```

**插件异常导致 DSH 无法启动时，临时禁用**（等修复后取消）：同样在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 加一行即可，无需卸载：

```yaml
- id: dsh-memory-evolve
  disabled: true
```

**从旧版本升级**：若你此前按旧文档手动 insert 过本插件，请删除 profile patch 里的 insert 行（否则与 bundle 自动注册重复）。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-memory-evolve`，一切效果随插件卸载自动清理。

---

## 认识它（30 秒）

装上插件后，打开任意会话，你会多出一排能力标签：**记忆 · 技能 · 待办 · 无限画板 · COI 调度 · 会话广播 · 提示词 · 记忆同步 · 模型设置 · 书签 · 会话评审 · Web UI 设置 · Memory Evolve 设置**。AI 侧则多了一批工具：记忆读写、待办、技能管理、本地文件搜索、会话编排、会话广播、外部 AI 派单、提示词注入、模型查询……

一句话概括这些能力：**让 AI 记住你、替你管、替你做、互相配合做。**

> 小提示：插件里很多能力默认关闭（不占 AI 的工具清单），需要时在「Memory Evolve 设置」里打开即可。下面的场景大多是组合玩法——**把相关功能都打开，才能串成完整的流水线**。

---

## 场景一：让 AI 真正记住你（长期记忆）

**适合谁**：所有人。这是插件的核心，也是其他一切功能的地基。

AI 的对话是「一次性」的：换项目、隔几天、开新会话，它就忘了你是谁。插件的五轨记忆让 AI 拥有**跨会话的长期工作记忆**：

- **用户档案**：你的偏好、公司、沟通习惯——AI 每回合都能看到；
- **全局事实**：环境、工具、惯例等长期知识；
- **项目关键记忆**：当前项目的约定、决策、架构、踩坑，自动注入上下文，重要结论可标记**只在某个 git 分支生效**；
- **项目日志 / 每日日志**：每回合自动记录进展，按需读取，历史可追溯。

**怎么用**：

1. 正常和 AI 对话即可——每回合结束时它会自动把进展写进项目日志和今日日志；
2. 发现重要事实时对它说「**记一下：这个项目的部署端口是 8080**」，它会写入项目关键记忆，**你确认后**才生效——AI 不会擅自往记忆里写东西；
3. 过几天、换了个会话，直接问「**查一下记忆，上次我们定下的架构决策是什么**」——它能无缝衔接；
4. 记忆多了之后，让 AI「**把 XX 那条记忆归档**」——归档条目不再注入上下文，随时可转回；
5. **情绪反馈记录**：你对工作结果的评价（如「太好了」「怎么还没改对」）会被 AI 记入当日与项目日志（`【反馈】` 行，含情绪、任务分类、你的原话）——积累后随时可以让 AI「**分析一下最近我对哪些方面不满意**」，判断它在哪类任务上做得好/不好。

**会得到什么**：AI 从一个「每次会话都失忆」的对话机器，变成了解你全盘工作的长期伙伴——隔天继续开发，它直接引用昨天的结论，不用你复述。

---

## 场景：多台电脑共享项目记忆（记忆同步）

**适合谁**：办公室和家里两台电脑干活、或有同事协作同一个项目的人——不想在每台电脑上把重要结论重新讲一遍。

**怎么用**（详见 [记忆同步](docs/记忆同步.md)）：

1. 「Memory Evolve 设置 → 配置」打开「**记忆同步**」模块开关（这只是让功能可见）；
2. 在项目会话的「**记忆同步**」Tab 打开「**本项目同步**」——点「开始同步」即可（记忆远端默认用你的代码仓库，自动存进专属分支，不污染代码），再点「同步并推送」完成首次推送；**代码公开（如 GitHub 开源）但记忆想私藏**？填一个**共享记忆仓库**地址——一个仓库装所有项目的记忆（每项目一条专属分支），记忆与代码彻底隔离；
3. 另一台电脑 clone 项目后打开——**自动认亲**（同一仓库地址 = 同一项目），拉下来即可继续用；
4. 平时照常写记忆（实时落盘、零延迟），攒一批点一次「同步」；两台电脑都改了同一条记忆才会出现冲突，Tab 里选「采用本机 / 采用远端 / 两者都要」即可。

**会得到什么**：项目关键记忆、项目日志、归档、项目待办跨设备一致；填了共享记忆仓库后，**全局记忆（用户档案/每日日志/待办）也能跨设备**（四个独立轨开关，开哪个同步哪个）——换电脑不换记忆。**没开同步的项目完全不受影响**（保持纯本地状态）。

---

## 场景二：多项目并行开发，每件事都不丢（待办 + 项目日志 + 本地搜索）

**适合谁**：同时维护多个项目、经常被「之前那个方案是怎么定的」卡住的开发者。

- **四轨待办**：生活 / 工作 / 项目 / 每日。「项目」轨按工作目录隔离，换目录互不干扰。说「**记住，周五前把二级面板部署到手机访问实例**」，自动落成项目待办（带重要/紧急、截止日期）；每天收尾 AI 会提醒你到期的待办；
- **项目日志**：每个项目的进展按目录隔离沉淀，日志自动带 `[git main]` 分支标记，可溯源；
- **本地文件搜索**：对 AI 说「**搜一下本机有没有写过类似的东西**」——按文件名找文档（可扩展到全类型）；也能内容检索：「**哪个文档里提过 XX**」直接返回命中文件和片段。

**怎么用**：

1. 新项目开工直接开聊，项目日志自动建档；
2. 冒出的想法对 AI 说「记住」，它会进待确认队列——到「待办」里**采纳或拒绝**，你说了算；
3. 想不起来就问「之前有个文档提到过 XX」。

**会得到什么**：同时开 3 个项目也不乱——每个项目的记忆、待办、文档线索各归各的目录，问一句就能捡起来。

---

## 场景三：一个人指挥一群 AI 干活（内部团队）

**适合谁**：想把 AI 用成「团队」的人——一个主会话指挥美工、前端、后端、测试多个子会话。

**怎么用**：

1. **拉起团队**：对主会话的 AI 说「**创建 4 个会话：美工负责网站视觉、前端负责页面、后端负责接口、测试负责验收，把它们拉进同一个协作房间**」——它立刻创建 4 个标准会话（出现在左侧列表、随时可接管），自动继承你的模型与工作目录；创建时可指定 **Agent 预设**（如「用代码模式创建前端会话」），决定该会话的工具面与人格；
2. **协作沟通**：房间建好后，**谁改了什么、谁干完了，全员可见**；成员状态（正在生成 / 空闲）变化会自动收到「房间动态」通知；**房间消息可以带图片**——截图直接发群里，接收方 AI 通过 read 拿到图片文件路径，可读图、可转发到 IM 渠道；
3. **派活与催活**：问 AI「**现在谁在干活、谁空闲了**」，它会查看各会话状态；对空闲的会话说「**叫前端把结果发过来**」，AI 自动唤醒它并派活——不会批量自动唤醒，一切由你（或你的主会话）有意识地指挥；
4. **防冲突**：同一项目多个会话并行改代码时，开工前对 AI 说「**声明一下你要改哪些文件**」——其他人（及其 AI）能看到「谁在改什么」；真撞车了，写入方会收到冲突警告，还有「工作区活动」通知（并行开始/结束、成员变化时单独推送）随时告知谁在跑、在干什么；
5. **结果回传**：各成员干完把结果发回房间，你汇总确认。

**持续运转（关键）**：主会话自己一直在运行，所以它能**随时唤醒已经休息（空闲）的会话继续干活**——催活、收结果、派下一轮，哪怕你不在电脑前，队伍也能一路推进到出结果。唯一的前提是**主会话所在的 DSH 进程保持运行**；如果主会话空闲了或 DSH 被关掉，唤醒链就停了——需要你回来发一条消息，队伍重新开动。

**会得到什么**：一个人的开发产出，变成一个小团队的吞吐。任务交接、唤醒、冲突预警全链路自动化，房间消息留痕可查。

---

## 场景四：重活派给外部 AI 代理（外部外援）

**适合谁**：需要把大任务（视觉重设计、代码审查、完整功能开发）交给专用 AI 代理（Kimi / Codex / Grok / Hermes）的用户——不想被阻塞，又不想错过结果。

**怎么用**：

1. 对 AI 说「**把这个任务派给 grok：移动端适配改造**」——后台异步执行，立即返回任务号，**不卡当前会话**，你可以继续聊别的；
2. 期间随时问「**任务进度如何**」，或在「COI 调度」里看实时日志流；
3. 派单时 AI 可自主选择带上你的项目记忆——外部代理也「懂项目约定」；
4. **派单可以带图**：对 AI 说「**把这张截图发给 grok 分析**」——附件支持本地路径/远程 URL/本会话图片（你在输入框贴的图），codex/kimi/hermes 都能真看图（grok 走 prompt 读图，zcode 纯文本会明确拒绝）；
5. 完成后结果摘要**自动写入项目日志与今日日志**——派出去的活自动变成你的记忆资产。

**会得到什么**：AI 派活给 AI，你只负责确认验收。视觉改版、深度代码审查、批量重构这类「重活」都能甩出去，主会话保持轻快。

---

## 场景五：内外协同——一支队伍，两种兵种

**适合谁**：任务大到单靠一边搞不定的人。这是插件协作能力的完全体：**内部会话负责「需要上下文和来回打磨的活」，外部代理负责「一次性重活」，两者通过记忆、房间、提示词串成一条流水线。**

一个完整的真实流程（产品视觉改版）：

1. **分工**：主会话 spawn 前端、测试两个内部会话并拉进房间；同时把「全站视觉重设计」派给外部代理 Kimi；
2. **外部主刀**：Kimi 后台跑重设计（不占任何会话）；期间内部前端会话先做数据层和页面结构，不干等；
3. **接力**：Kimi 完成，摘要自动沉淀进项目记忆——主会话把设计结论发到房间，前端会话**读记忆拿到设计规范**，开始集成；
4. **问题升级**：集成中发现一个诡异样式问题，前端会话卡住——主会话把这个 bug 派给 Grok 深挖，结论回房间，前端会话照结论修复；
5. **验收**：测试会话跑完验收流程，结果发回房间，你最后确认。

协作的四个结合点，可以自由组合：

- **任务接力**：外部代理的产出（摘要/结论）自动进记忆 → 内部会话接力执行——**外部做重活，内部做集成与打磨**；
- **问题升级**：内部会话遇到难啃的问题 → 主会话派给外部代理深挖 → 结论回房间——**内部快节奏迭代，外部慢工出细活**；
- **标准统一**：给外部代理派活时，注入你沉淀的提示词（如「代码审查清单」「PRD 规范」）——**外部代理按你的流程干活，不靠运气**；
- **状态同步**：谁在跑、谁干完了，房间 + 工作区活动 + 通知随时可见——**你不用当人肉调度员**。

**会得到什么**：一条「外部主刀 → 内部集成 → 测试验收 → 你确认」的完整流水线。大任务不再是一个人（或一个 AI）硬扛，而是内外两支队伍分工协作。

---

## 场景六：AI 的自我纪律——提示词注入

**适合谁**：想把「好用的工作方法」沉淀下来、让每个 AI（包括外部代理）都按同一套流程干活的人。

提示词库是**指令范式资产库**：代码审查、调试、PRD、测试策略……把常用的工作方法固化成提示词（可分类、可搜索、可启用/禁用）。

**怎么用**：

1. **AI 自己选、自己注入**：AI 觉得当前任务适用某套流程时，它会自己查看提示词库、选中合适的提示词注入自己——「接下来按代码审查清单执行」；下一轮它自动遵循，**不打断当前回复**；也能「立即注入」，当前回合马上生效；
2. **你一键注入**：在「提示词注入」里选中一条，点「注入一次 / 持续注入 / 立即注入」——持续注入就是「每回合提醒 AI 按此纪律干活」；
3. **临时注入**：不建提示词，直接输入一段要求注入，自动存入库中，下次复用；
4. **派活带纪律**：给子会话、外部代理派活时，让 AI 把对应提示词一起带上——**整个团队用同一套标准**。

**会得到什么**：好方法不再只存在你脑子里或一次对话里——它变成可复用的「团队操作手册」，AI 会主动遵守，你只管维护手册质量。

---

## 场景七：会话太长、太贵、容易糊——书签与分支

**适合谁**：对上下文开销敏感、一个会话动辄上百轮的深度用户。

- **会话书签**：每一轮都可以点星（☆）标记，「书签」列出全部书签（名称/轮次/时间/摘要，可搜索），**点击一键跳回任意一轮**——探索到「这个结论很重要」就打个星；
- **任意轮分支**：官方只支持从最后一轮创建分支；本插件把**中间任意轮的分支入口接管**——书签列表点「分支」（或直接点官方分支按钮，中间轮会弹出确认），走官方分支通道创建新会话，进入官方分支谱系；
- **上下文占用提醒**：输入框圆环实时显示上下文占用——≥30% 变黄、≥40% 变红，提醒你该打书签、该开分支、该开新会话了。

**怎么用**：

1. 探索性会话在关键轮次点 ☆，给书签起个名字（如「方案 A 评审结论」）；
2. 想从中间某个决策点另开一条线，书签列表点「分支」；
3. 看到圆环变红，把当前会话打个书签，开新会话继续。

**会得到什么**：上下文不再是一根只能从头滚到尾的绳子，而是**带锚点、可分支、可跳转的时间线**——每一轮的探索成果都能被精准复用，不会再因为「会话太长了」被迫放弃中间的好结论。

---

## 场景八：离开电脑也能用（手机访问 + 会话筛选 + 通知）

**适合谁**：离开电脑也想继续和 AI 协作、或者同时开很多会话看不过来的人。

- **手机浏览器访问**：DSH 界面适配了手机——对话区/消息气泡满宽、输入栏「⋯」上拉收纳工具栏与模型选择，手机上操作和电脑端一致；
- **会话列表筛选**：左侧列表可只显示「进行中的会话」，一屏看清谁在干活——桌面端同样适用；
- **渠道通知（de_notify）**：对 AI 说「任务完成用飞书通知我」，重要结果推到飞书/QQ/微信/企业微信，电脑前/手机上立刻知道（通知内容带「这是通知」标注，可附图片/文件）；
- **web 站内通知（de_notify channels=web）**：对 AI 说「发个站内通知给我」，通知直接落到**网页右上角的铃铛**——未读数字徽标 + 弹窗列表，能看到「哪个会话发来什么」，点主题跳转到那个会话、长内容点「查看详情」打开大弹窗看全文；铃铛可随意拖动、松手吸附到屏幕左/右边缘（位置记忆）。发到 web 和发到飞书等 IM 是同一句话，只是换个送达目的地（channels 传 `web`，或 `all` 一起发）；
- **渠道直发（de_channel_send）**：AI 随时主动把文本/图片/文件发到你的 IM 渠道（不带通知标注）——「把生成的图片/文档发给我」类场景；四个渠道（飞书/QQ/微信/企微）全部支持，附件来源可选本地路径/远程 URL/内联 base64/**本会话图片**（sessionImage=true 直接转发你在 DSH 输入框粘贴/拖入发送的图；attachmentId 显式引用，配合 de_session_images 先查本会话有哪些图，需 DSH 260810+ 快照）。

**会得到什么**：重活照派、进度照盯，人不用守在电脑前——回电脑后从左侧列表接管会话继续。

---

## 场景九：给每个会话配一个隐形评审员（会话评审）

**适合谁**：想让 AI 干活时有一双"第二眼睛"把关、又不想自己逐句盯的人——尤其是项目里定了纪律（如"回复前先说明自己在哪个目录"）却总发现 AI 聊着聊着就忘了的情况。

**能做什么**：

- **独立评审员**：给每个会话挂一个独立的评审会话，它**只观察你在界面上看到的对话**（用户说的话 + Agent 的回复正文），看不到思考过程、工具调用参数等内部细节——像旁边坐了一位只旁听对话、不碰键盘的同事；
- **每轮实时评审**：对话每推进一轮，评审员就基于**完整上下文**评审一次——它是持续会话，像普通 LLM 长对话一样记住全部历史、**永不截断**，不会"忘了前面说过什么"；
- **需要时实时提醒（steer）**：评审员发现值得说的点，会以**用户指令的形式**注入当前会话——Agent 会把它当成你说的话直接执行（2026-08-13 拍板：实测带"非用户指令"标记会让 Agent 质疑来源、执行力下降，所以伪装成用户指令效果最好）；GUI 对话流中这类消息显示为**折叠行 `[severity]` 前缀**，方便你一眼认出哪些话其实是评审员说的；
- **四级严重度**：`info`（仅记录、默认不注入主会话，可配置注入）/ `nit`（小建议）/ `concern`（值得处理）/ `blocker`（必须立即处理）——不是所有话都打断，只有该说的才说；
- **新建评审会话**：面板里一键清空评审员的上下文与记忆重来——新会话第一条指令由你告诉它背景，上下文长度由你掌控；
- **直接向评审员提问**：面板里随时提问，它立即回答（回答只在评审面板展示，不注入主会话流）——像随时可以问的旁听同事；
- **四层级约束**：系统提示词（全局默认，可查看全文/修改/一键恢复）/ **项目约束**（本工作区共享）/ **会话约束**（本会话保留）/ **本次评审会话约束**（随"新建评审会话"清空）——四层拼接注入，冲突时越局部越优先；
- **记录可查**：评审记录 JSONL 持久化，面板「记录」可追溯。

**怎么用**：

1. 「Memory Evolve 设置 → 配置」打开「**会话评审**」（`advisorEnabled`，默认关闭）；评审模型缺省继承当前会话模型，也可单独配置 `advisorProvider`/`advisorModel`；
2. 会话页出现「会话评审」悬浮窗，点开面板即可看到评审员的实时评审流与上下文占用；
3. 在「约束」Tab 给评审员立规矩（如项目约束："每次回复前先说明自己在哪个目录"），保存立即生效；
4. 想让评审员重头开始就点「**新建评审会话**」；想直接问它就点「**提问**」；
5. Agent 侧：评审提醒以折叠行 `[severity]` 出现在对话流里——你能看到评审员说了什么、Agent 是否照做。

**会得到什么**：每个 AI 会话都多了一位持续在岗的"旁听同事"——它不打断你的节奏，只在关键时刻以你的口吻提醒 Agent 纠偏；项目纪律、会话约束有人替你盯着，不会聊着聊着就忘了规矩。

---

## 场景十：散落的素材，一块画板装下（无限画板）

**适合谁**：设计稿在下载目录、合同在文档库、参考图在桌面、录音在个人文件夹——每次要用都得开 Finder 一层层翻的人；以及想让 AI"看得见"你手头素材、又不想把素材一股脑塞进对话上下文的人。

**能做什么**：

- **素材集中上板**：三种入口——**路径上板**（粘贴本地路径）、**便签**（画板内直接写，内容不落盘）、**搜索上板**（真实搜本机文件，搜到一键上板）；文本类文件上板后自动读取内容；
- **一眼看见**：无限平移/缩放画布，卡片自由摆放、右下角拖拽调大小；图片/音视频/文本在画板内直接预览，Word/PDF 等走系统默认应用打开；
- **单板 + 视角筛选**：物理上一块画板，节点带归属徽标（🌐 全局 / 📁 项目 / 💬 会话）；默认会话视角看"自己会话 + 当前项目 + 全局"，切「项目」看该项目全部会话，切「全局」看所有；
- **快速调用**：复制节点 ID / 标题 / 路径 / 引用串（`[canvas:id] 标题`），把引用串丢给 AI，它就能凭 id 找到素材；
- **AI 双向（拉取式）**：AI 用 `de_canvas` 工具按 id 查画板、读素材内容、往画板中央区放便签（带「AI 放置」标记）——**画板内容不注入上下文**，需要时主动查，省 token 不打扰；
- **本地路径引用**：文件留在原地，画板只记"指向哪里"——源文件改动实时可见，删除源文件后卡片显示失效提示；
- **安全边界**：AI 只能读**已上板**的节点（没有任意路径读取 API）；敏感目录（.ssh/.config 等）即使上板也拒绝代理。

**怎么用**：

1. 「Memory Evolve 设置 → 配置」打开「**无限画板**」（`canvasEnabled`，默认关闭）；
2. 会话页出现「画板」Tab：路径上板 / 便签 / 搜索上板，卡片自由摆；
3. 点卡片「引用」复制引用串，对 AI 说"去画板拿 XX"——AI 用 `de_canvas` 查/读/放便签；
4. AI 放的便签落在画板中央虚线区，拖到想要的位置即可。

**会得到什么**：告别"文件在哪来着"的反复翻找——素材集中一块画板，人和 AI 在同一张桌子上干活：你摆、AI 拿；AI 放、你看。

---

## 还有这些能力（一句话索引）

- **技能自我进化**：反复踩坑的方法论自动固化成技能，同类任务下次直接按流程执行；
- **技能管理**：记忆 Tab 里浏览/搜索/禁用/编辑全部技能、添加自定义技能目录（原独立插件 dsh-skills-manager 已合并进本插件，旧插件用户升级前先按安装文档卸载旧插件）；
- **无限画板**：把散落各处的文件/文本/图片/音视频集中到一块无限画布上陈列——本地路径引用、单板+视角筛选（会话/项目/全局）、画板内直接预览/复制/引用；AI 也能按 id 读画板素材、往画板中央区放便签（de_canvas）；
- **会话搜索**：让 AI 搜索本机其他 AI 工具（如 Codex）的历史会话——「之前 Codex 里做过 XX」直接问；
- **模型配置**：插件侧维护各模型的启用状态、思考等级、备注，并标注**是否支持图片输入**（🖼 标记，AI 选模型时一目了然）；
- **回合内记忆审查**：每隔 N 轮，AI 主动提炼值得记住的信息交给你确认——记忆库自己会生长；
- **版本检测与更新**：多设备/多用户部署时，「Memory Evolve 设置」Tab 的「版本」页自动检测远端发布版本（git tag v0.x.y），检测到新版本时设置 Tab 出现 🔴 红点，由你决定是否更新（详见下方「发布版本」）；
- **会话评审（Advisor）**：给每个会话挂一个独立评审员——只观察界面可见对话（不含思考/工具调用），每轮实时评审、需要时以用户指令形式实时提醒（info/nit/concern/blocker 四级；info 默认仅记录），持续会话永不截断，支持新建评审会话/直接提问/四层级约束/记录可查。默认关闭，详见[场景九](#场景九给每个会话配一个隐形评审员会话评审)。
- **web 站内通知**：渠道通知（de_notify）新增 `web` 渠道——AI 发通知直接落到网页右上角铃铛（未读徽标 + 弹窗列表 + 点主题跳会话 + 长文大弹窗 + 拖拽吸附左右），与飞书等 IM 渠道同一套通知语义。默认关闭，随「通知模块」（`notifyEnabled`）开关启用，详见[场景八](#场景八离开电脑也能用手机访问--会话筛选--通知)。

每个功能的完整说明，在对应标签页的「指南」里。

---

## 发布版本

插件使用 **git tag** 作为发布版本标识（两种格式都支持：**日期戳 `v<纯数字>`** 如 `v26081302`（日常发版推荐）、语义化 `v1.2.3`）：日常开发推送 main 分支不会触发任何更新提示，只有打了发布 tag 才会被各设备检测到。

**发版流程（开发者）**：

```bash
# 1. 提交并推送 main（tag 必须打在已推送的 main 提交上）
git push origin main

# 2. 用发版脚本一键完成：工作树/远端同步检查 → 构建 → 全量测试 → 打 annotated tag → 推送 tag
bash ~/shell/dsh-memory-evolve-release.sh v26081302 -m "发布说明：……"
```

**各设备更新（使用者）**：

- 进入 Web UI 后自动检测（24 小时内最多自动检测一次，也可点「检查更新」强制检测；插件启动时也会后台检测一次）；
- 检测到新版本时，设置 Tab 出现 🔴 红点；进入「版本」页点击「更新到 v26081302」；
- 更新完成后**必须重启 dsh web 再刷新浏览器**（仅刷新页面不会加载新代码）；
- 更新后插件处于 detached HEAD（跟随发布 tag）：继续用「版本」页的更新按钮升级即可，**不要直接 `git pull`**；
- 想回到开发轨：`git checkout main && git pull --ff-only`。

**更新安全机制**：只接受严格格式（v<纯数字> 或 v1.2.3）且位于 origin/main 历史的 tag；更新前校验本地工作树干净；更新过程有跨进程锁与失败回滚，不会把半更新状态留给你。

---

## 三条原则

1. **AI 只提议，你确认**：AI 自建的记忆、待办、技能都先进待确认队列——所有会真实改变 AI 行为的写入，决定权都在你；
2. **不重复造轮子**：官方已有的能力不碰，只做官方没做、且真实解决痛点的；
3. **内外有别、协作互补**：内部会话负责需要上下文的活，外部代理负责一次性重活，记忆、房间、提示词把它们串成一条流水线。

## 安装

```
# npm 包（预构建）
dsh plugin --profile web add <npm-package>

# GitHub 源码（首次需按提示配置 allowBuilds 构建授权后重试）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:owner/repo
```

装任何插件都等于在你的机器上跑第三方代码，权限和你本人一样大——能读你的文件、用你的凭据、访问网络，工具审批管不到它。GitHub 来源的插件还会在安装时执行构建脚本——pnpm 默认拦截，所以安装可能停在 ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED 或 ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS ；dsh 会打印出需要添加的确切键名，把它加进该 profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 的 allowBuilds 下，重跑一次即可装上。放行构建本身就是一次信任判断：请只安装可信来源，并尽量锁定 commit（ github:owner/repo#sha ）。

## 收录你的插件

给 awesome-dsh-plugin (https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 提一个 PR：在 data/plugins/ 下新增一个 YAML 文件就是完整投稿，README 与本站会自动重新生成。也请为你的仓库打上 dsh-plugin (https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic。
↑
© 2026 awesome-dsh-plugin · GitHub (https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) · 隐私政策 (/zh/privacy/) · 与 DeepSeek 无隶属关系 · 探索未至之境 插件由各自作者开发维护，收录不构成背书；安装即运行第三方代码，请自行审阅源码、风险自担。

## 安装

```
# npm 包（预构建）
dsh plugin --profile web add <npm-package>

# GitHub 源码（首次需按提示配置 allowBuilds 构建授权后重试）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:owner/repo
```

装任何插件都等于在你的机器上跑第三方代码，权限和你本人一样大——能读你的文件、用你的凭据、访问网络，工具审批管不到它。GitHub 来源的插件还会在安装时执行构建脚本——pnpm 默认拦截，所以安装可能停在 ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED 或 ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS ；dsh 会打印出需要添加的确切键名，把它加进该 profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 的 allowBuilds 下，重跑一次即可装上。放行构建本身就是一次信任判断：请只安装可信来源，并尽量锁定 commit（ github:owner/repo#sha ）。

## 收录你的插件

给 awesome-dsh-plugin (https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 提一个 PR：在 data/plugins/ 下新增一个 YAML 文件就是完整投稿，README 与本站会自动重新生成。也请为你的仓库打上 dsh-plugin (https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic。
↑
© 2026 awesome-dsh-plugin · GitHub (https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) · 隐私政策 (/zh/privacy/) · 与 DeepSeek 无隶属关系 · 探索未至之境 插件由各自作者开发维护，收录不构成背书；安装即运行第三方代码，请自行审阅源码、风险自担。

## 安装

```
# npm 包（预构建）
dsh plugin --profile web add <npm-package>

# GitHub 源码（首次需按提示配置 allowBuilds 构建授权后重试）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:owner/repo
```

装任何插件都等于在你的机器上跑第三方代码，权限和你本人一样大——能读你的文件、用你的凭据、访问网络，工具审批管不到它。GitHub 来源的插件还会在安装时执行构建脚本——pnpm 默认拦截，所以安装可能停在 ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED 或 ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS ；dsh 会打印出需要添加的确切键名，把它加进该 profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 的 allowBuilds 下，重跑一次即可装上。放行构建本身就是一次信任判断：请只安装可信来源，并尽量锁定 commit（ github:owner/repo#sha ）。

## 收录你的插件

给 awesome-dsh-plugin (https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 提一个 PR：在 data/plugins/ 下新增一个 YAML 文件就是完整投稿，README 与本站会自动重新生成。也请为你的仓库打上 dsh-plugin (https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic。
↑
© 2026 awesome-dsh-plugin · GitHub (https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) · 隐私政策 (/zh/privacy/) · 与 DeepSeek 无隶属关系 · 探索未至之境 插件由各自作者开发维护，收录不构成背书；安装即运行第三方代码，请自行审阅源码、风险自担。

# dsh-memory-evolve bundle patch: inserts the host row into the profile's
# plugin roster. The browser half rides the package's `dsh.client` manifest
# (the client registry serves lib/client.js), and this row materializes the
# memory / skills / todos / CLI-dispatch host plugin on boot.
# Install with `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <path-or-git-url>`; the bundle
# patch is applied automatically, so do NOT insert this row again in the
# profile patch (duplicate ids crash the loader).
- insert:
    - id: dsh-memory-evolve
      name: 'dsh-memory-evolve'

# dsh-memory-evolve

为 DeepSeek Harness 带来「跨会话长期记忆 + 后台自我进化」能力的纯插件实现：**五轨记忆 · git 分支感知 · 回合内自我审查 · 技能自我进化与技能管理器 · 四轨待办 · COI 调度 · 会话广播 · 会话编排 · 会话搜索 · 提示词管理器 · 临时信息便签 · 模型设置 · Web UI 设置**——**零核心修改、零运行时依赖**，随装随用、卸载即净。

> **🚀 COI 调度使用文档**：[docs/COI-调度.md](docs/COI-调度.md) —— 把任务派给 kimi/codex/grok/hermes 等外部 CLI：三层入口、适配器管理、会话分层、记忆注入、命令/工具参考。**默认禁用**，启用见「Memory Evolve 设置」Tab 的「配置」。
>
> **📖 记忆与审查规则（功能说明）**：[docs/rules.md](docs/rules.md) —— 五层记忆如何工作、审查何时触发与产出什么、什么该记什么不该记、哪些需要你确认。README 只讲安装与配置。
>
